sentences.zh: 每样东西都有一个名字。

sentences.en: A part of the cake is on the plate.
sentences.zh: 蛋糕的一部分在盘子上。

sentences.en: The end of the road is near the river.
The pen is on one side of the book.
Draw a straight line on the paper.
The top of the mountain is white with snow.
The middle of the room has a table.
The front of the car is red.
The back of the house has a garden.
sentences.zh: 房子的后面有一个花园。

sentences.en: There is a hole in my sock.
The edge of the knife is sharp.
The hollow inside the tree was home for birds.
The structure of the building was strong.
The substance inside the bottle was water.
The stretch of land from here to the sea is flat.
sentences.zh: 从这里到海边的这片土地是平坦的。
